body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Until your next turn, perceive ordinary concealment sources within 2 units of the point and identify whether they are mundane or magical; hidden creatures are not automatically detected.

surges.html: Suppress one ordinary visual impairment on yourself until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Rite - Divination
rider.html: Rite, 2 Echoes: anchor the point. Trigger: an enemy enters within 1 unit. Echo: reveal its occupied space through ordinary concealment until your next turn; solid barriers still block awareness.
